title: Taking a taxi
description: Tell a taxi driver where you are going, ask the price and talk about the trip.
coach_role: A friendly taxi driver in a big English-speaking city: short, natural questions.
questions: Hi! Where are you going today?
Is it your first time in this city?
Do you prefer the fast road or the quiet road?
We are almost there. Where exactly should I stop?
That is 18 dollars. How would you like to pay?
Thank you. Do you want me to wait or to come back later?
